components.name: volume_anomaly

components.name: volatility_transition
components.formula: ln(sample_stdev(last S log returns)/sample_stdev(first N log returns))/sqrt(1/(2*(S-1))+1/(2*(N-1)))
components.origin: 214947a: inherited N/S and cutoff; large-sample log-scale approximation, finite-sample operational tails uncalibrated
components.available_evidence: frozen scans, existing fixtures; fixed 3x last-five volatility plants and stationary null controls

components.name: relative_return_divergence
components.formula: (sum(last S log returns)-median_cohort(sum(last S log returns)))/(sample_stdev(first N log returns)*sqrt(S))
components.origin: 214947a: inherited prototype scales/cohort floor; sample denominator and estimated cohort median alter tails
components.available_evidence: frozen scan membership and rows; isolated fixture and fixed recent-mean plants; no independent natural-event labels

components.name: world_volume_anomaly
components.formula: abs(accepted WorldModel volume_anomaly with unit z_score); normal producer duplicates existing volume formula exactly
components.origin: 640a5f2: package seam using existing volume_z transform; no extra confidence multiplier
components.available_evidence: current source producer and pure duplicate parity controls; none of the inventoried stores provides a separate calibrated world-label set
components.activation: optional worker world_model; disabled by current config; not passed into broad admission

components.name: positioning_extreme
components.formula: max over funding/ls_ratio of abs((anchor-mean(previous 20 values))/sample_stdev(previous 20 values))
components.origin: 640a5f2: package-owned reference20, per code; timing constants follow recorder cadence/slack, not calibrated event-error tolerances
components.available_evidence: 59 scans contain no positioning input; additional exact-cut derivs.db anchor inventory: BTC funding usable, BTC ls_ratio and both ETH series stale. No natural-event labels. Stationary and +3-sigma algebra controls remain conditional.
components.activation: optional worker captured derivatives; not supplied to broad admission

components.name: correlation_change
components.formula: abs((atanh(r_recent)-atanh(r_baseline))/sqrt(1/(120-3)+1/(30-3))); r against one frozen leave-one-out equal-weight peer basket
components.origin: 640a5f2: package-owned 120/30 windows, Fisher approximation; explicitly a deterministic feature, not calibrated test
components.available_evidence: latest operational frozen scan may carry correlation_input; exact-grid existing correlation fixture; stable-null and 0.8-to-zero plants
components.activation: normal admission when 151 closes available; worker optional captured correlation

components.name: market_breadth
components.formula: breadth_up=count(R_S>0)/cohort_size; market_z=median(R_S)/(median(sigma_long)*sqrt(S)); broad iff abs(market_z)>=1.5 and max(up,1-up)>=0.75
components.origin: 214947a: inherited prototype defaults, explicitly uncalibrated; supporting framing, not extra salience term
components.available_evidence: frozen market rows and existing broad/contested fixtures; no real-market labelled broad-event acceptance set

components.name: participation
components.formula: ln(current/previous) within exact same (kind,source), both endpoints available; supporting evidence iff abs(change)>=0.05
components.origin: 214947a: inherited prototype supporting-evidence threshold; not score term
components.available_evidence: existing synthetic participation/late-revision tests; normal capture participation empty; no retained natural labelled calibration
components.activation: optional cognition research input; normal capture input empty
